trust_decision.summary: The RichText/Markdown preview decides trust at rich-text-preview.svelte:218 with DOMPurify `sanitize(rawHTML, SANITIZE_OPTIONS)`, and SANITIZE_OPTIONS (helper.js:21-25) permits `<iframe>` while constraining neither its `src` scheme/origin nor its `sandbox`, so any iframe markup committed with the entry (e.g. a relative same-origin path) reaches the `{@html}` sink at line 239 unsandboxed; the published fix moves the decision into a service helper that post-processes iframes (validateIframe + sanitizeRichTextHTML, fix.diff:82-147).

landing_point.why: It is the only call that turns markdown into HTML for the `{@html}` sink at line 239, and the advisory summary names the Markdown/RichText preview, which is exactly this component (widgets `richtext` and alias `markdown`, see src/lib/components/contents/details/fields/index.js:79,83).

fix_sites.entry_point: RichText/Markdown field preview in the entry editor (component rich-text-preview.svelte), reached for widgets `richtext` and alias `markdown` via src/lib/components/contents/details/preview/field-preview.svelte:94
fix_sites.module_kind: service/helper module (plain JS, exported consts and functions)

fix_sites.entry_point: RichText/Markdown field preview in the entry editor (same single entry point; the component's per-markdown-block parser callback)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: `sanitize_preview: false` is a documented per-field/`field_defaults.richtext` opt-out for admins who fully trust every CMS user (src/lib/types/public.js:757-760), so the unsanitized branch at rich-text-preview.svelte:218 predates and is outside the advisory's sanitizer hardening.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate cross-origin HTTPS media embeds (YouTube/Vimeo and generic https embeds) must keep rendering in the rich-text preview with their `allow`, `allowfullscreen` and `referrerpolicy` attributes intact, and `blob:` image srcs must keep working for local upload previews; dropping `iframe` from ADD_TAGS or tightening ALLOWED_URI_REGEXP passes the advisory's example but kills all of these.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: src/lib/services/contents/fields/rich-text/helper.js:14-25 (blob: for local image previews, iframe for embedded media); fix.diff:293-346 (the fix's own tests require https embeds and allow/allowfullscreen/referrerpolicy to survive)

O6_input_shapes: iframe src scheme variants: javascript:, data:, blob:, file:, vbscript:, http:, about:blank, and mixed/upper-case spellings (fix.diff:176-217, 358-403)
relative and protocol-relative paths: leading `/`, `//host/...`, `./x`, `../x`, backslash form, whitespace-padded (fix.diff:219-267, 405-417)
absolute HTTPS URL whose origin equals window.location.origin (fix.diff:269-284)
malformed URLs that make `new URL()` throw (fix.diff:419-445)
pre-existing `sandbox` attribute: author tokens such as allow-popups must be merged with, not replaced by, the two enforced tokens; duplicate `sandbox` attributes (fix.diff:302-321, 447-455)
several iframes in one markdown block, only the safe one surviving (fix.diff:365-385)

O7_producer.where: src/lib/components/contents/details/fields/rich-text/rich-text-preview.svelte:215-218 (marked `parse(block, { breaks: true })` produces the HTML that is handed straight to the sanitizer on the next line; the markdown string itself is assembled by buildMarkdownWithPreviews at src/lib/services/contents/fields/rich-text/helper.js:212-264, which splices component `toPreview()` HTML from src/lib/services/contents/fields/rich-text/components/definitions.js:41-46,76-83)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: RichText preview with sanitization opted out (`sanitize_preview: false` per field or via `field_defaults.richtext`): the same marked output goes straight to `{@html}` at line 239, so the same unsandboxed same-origin iframe still reaches the sink and the fix changes nothing on this branch.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The option is documented as an intentional opt-out for trusted user bases (src/lib/types/public.js:757-760), so a solver can argue the unsanitized branch was never covered by the advisory's sanitizer fix.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file and same function as the landing point (0 files, 0 packages)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Markdown file preview that renders a repository `.md` asset through marked into `{@html sanitize(rawHTML)}`; a maintainer who wanted embeds in file previews would copy SANITIZE_OPTIONS there.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Identical marked+DOMPurify pattern over content a repository writer controls, four directories away from the fixed site and currently relying on bare DOMPurify defaults to strip iframes.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A `toPreview()` that emits an iframe (or an embed component added alongside `image`/`linked-image`) would produce HTML spliced into the markdown before parsing, so it would need the same validateIframe treatment.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: toPreview already returns raw HTML strings that are concatenated into the markdown string (helper.js:247-259), and editor components are a documented extensibility point (`CMS.registerEditorComponent`).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The string field's YouTube embed iframe, hard-coded to a vetted URL with `sandbox="allow-same-origin allow-scripts"`; a URL-driven embed variant for other providers would need validateIframe.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The pinned commit itself is 'Add sandbox attributes to embedded iframes' (871909f8), i.e. the maintainers were hardening this neighbouring iframe at the same time; extending embed support to arbitrary providers is the natural next change.

O9_family: cross-site scripting via unsanitized preview HTML (CWE-79)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Delete 'iframe' from ADD_TAGS in SANITIZE_OPTIONS (or narrow ALLOWED_URI_REGEXP), which removes the reported payload but also removes every legitimate YouTube/Vimeo embed and breaks blob: image previews.
